summary: Add fixture controls for two-consumer journal reopen after committed prune and process exit.

replay.detail: Test-only parent/child; no production replay or backfill.

schema.detail: No production SQL, DDL, index, trigger, migration or dependency change.

rules.detail: The unchanged production Installer chooses the journal cutoff; no copied minimum or image deletion.

compatibility.detail: Two authored, unrun names use a parent-owned full state oracle and original follower namespace, child prune16+0 then exact exit78/markers, and post-reopen original-reference catchup. No mutation has been executed; all prior prefixes and limits remain unchanged.

manual.detail: No configuration, nextest, activation, new worker or production factory change.

recovery.detail: Post-commit process death after a synced phase marker only, not SIGKILL, power loss, during-COMMIT or uncommitted crash. No identity/process-gate bypass or cleanup policy; image reclamation, work/hold/CPU, lifetime/authority and production adoption stay deferred.
